label: Aliases
description: Tracks and shows player aliases (past names) seen on the server.

commands.name: alias
commands.description: Provides a list of aliases the server is aware of for the player ID/Steam ID provided.

commands.name: setnoaliases
commands.description: Set/unset the 'noaliases' flag for a player, preventing that player's aliases from being listed by !alias.

commands.name: clearaliases
commands.description: Clears all alias records from the server database.

cvars.label: Output Line Limit
cvars.description: Max number of lines !alias prints before truncating.
